ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint_CCD] AS
BEGIN

--GET DELTA FROM BUSC

WITH Temp_BNKM_PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint_Union AS(
    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CRDACCT_NBR ORDER BY CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE DESC, Monthly_Daily) RN, * FROM(
    SELECT
    BCC.CRDACCT_NBR
    ,CASE 
        WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE = 0 THEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN
        ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE
    END AS CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_PRIOR_YR_BP
    ,CRDACCT_CTD_BP_ADD
    ,CRDACCT_CTD_BP_DED
    ,CRDACCT_MTD_BP_ADD
    ,CRDACCT_MTD_BP_DED
    ,CRDACCT_MTD_BP_MDB
    ,BCC.BNK_CODE
    ,1 AS Monthly_Daily
    FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP BCC
    WHERE isLatest = 1

    UNION

    SELECT
    BCC.CRDACCT_NBR
    ,CASE 
        WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE = 0 THEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_OPEN
        ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE
    END AS CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE
    ,BCC.CRDACCT_PRIOR_YR_BP
    ,CRDACCT_CTD_BP_ADD
    ,CRDACCT_CTD_BP_DED
    ,CRDACCT_MTD_BP_ADD
    ,CRDACCT_MTD_BP_DED
    ,CRDACCT_MTD_BP_MDB
    ,BCC.BNK_CODE
    ,2 AS Monthly_Daily
    FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP BCC
    WHERE isLatest = 1
    )a
)


SELECT * INTO #Temp_BNKM_PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint_Union FROM Temp_BNKM_PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint_Union WHERE RN = 1;


WITH Temp_BNKM_PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint AS(
SELECT
CRDACCT_NBR as CustomerAccountId
,'PRIOR YR BONUS POINT'as BonusPointTypeId
,CONVERT (date,convert(varchar,CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE)) as BonusPointTimestamp
,CRDACCT_PRIOR_YR_BP as BonusPointAmount
,'CCD' as SourceSystemCode
,BNK_CODE as FinancialInstitutionId
,0 as WorkFlowId
,0 as TaskRunId
,getdate() as InsertDttm
FROM #Temp_BNKM_PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint_Union

UNION

SELECT
CRDACCT_NBR as CustomerAccountId
,'CTD BONUS POINT ADD'as BonusPointTypeId
,CONVERT (date,convert(varchar,CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE)) as BonusPointTimestamp
,CRDACCT_CTD_BP_ADD as BonusPointAmount
,'CCD' as SourceSystemCode
,BNK_CODE as FinancialInstitutionId
,0 as WorkFlowId
,0 as TaskRunId
,getdate() as InsertDttm
FROM #Temp_BNKM_PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint_Union

UNION

SELECT
CRDACCT_NBR as CustomerAccountId
,'CTD BONUS POINT DED'as BonusPointTypeId
,CONVERT (date,convert(varchar,CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE)) as BonusPointTimestamp
,CRDACCT_CTD_BP_DED as BonusPointAmount
,'CCD' as SourceSystemCode
,BNK_CODE as FinancialInstitutionId
,0 as WorkFlowId
,0 as TaskRunId
,getdate() as InsertDttm
FROM #Temp_BNKM_PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint_Union

UNION

SELECT
CRDACCT_NBR as CustomerAccountId
,'MTD BONUS POINT ADD'as BonusPointTypeId
,CONVERT (date,convert(varchar,CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE)) as BonusPointTimestamp
,CRDACCT_MTD_BP_ADD as BonusPointAmount
,'CCD' as SourceSystemCode
,BNK_CODE as FinancialInstitutionId
,0 as WorkFlowId
,0 as TaskRunId
,getdate() as InsertDttm
FROM #Temp_BNKM_PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint_Union

UNION

SELECT
CRDACCT_NBR as CustomerAccountId
,'MTD BONUS POINT DED'as BonusPointTypeId
,CONVERT (date,convert(varchar,CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE)) as BonusPointTimestamp
,CRDACCT_MTD_BP_DED as BonusPointAmount
,'CCD' as SourceSystemCode
,BNK_CODE as FinancialInstitutionId
,0 as WorkFlowId
,0 as TaskRunId
,getdate() as InsertDttm
FROM #Temp_BNKM_PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint_Union

UNION

SELECT
CRDACCT_NBR as CustomerAccountId
,'MTD BONUS POINT MDB'as BonusPointTypeId
,CONVERT (date,convert(varchar,CRDACCT_DELTA_DATE)) as BonusPointTimestamp
,CRDACCT_MTD_BP_MDB as BonusPointAmount
,'CCD' as SourceSystemCode
,BNK_CODE as FinancialInstitutionId
,0 as WorkFlowId
,0 as TaskRunId
,getdate() as InsertDttm
FROM #Temp_BNKM_PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint_Union
)

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

SELECT * INTO #Temp_BNKM_PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint FROM Temp_BNKM_PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint;

WITH Temp_BNKM_PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint_SRC AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
CONVERT(nvarchar,CustomerAccountId)
,CONVERT(varchar,BonusPointTypeId)
,CONVERT(datetime,BonusPointTimestamp )
,CONVERT(decimal,BonusPointAmount)
))HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, BonusPointTypeId, BonusPointTimestamp, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM #Temp_BNKM_PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint
)
,
Temp_BNKM_PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint_TGT AS (
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
CONVERT(nvarchar,CustomerAccountId)
,CONVERT(varchar,BonusPointTypeId)
,CONVERT(datetime,BonusPointTimestamp )
,CONVERT(decimal,BonusPointAmount)
))HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, BonusPointTypeId, BonusPointTimestamp, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint
WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'
)
,
Temp_BNKM_PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint_DELTA AS(
SELECT
SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
,ISNULL(SRC.BonusPointTypeId,TGT.BonusPointTypeId) AS BonusPointTypeId
,ISNULL(SRC.BonusPointTimestamp,TGT.BonusPointTimestamp) AS BonusPointTimestamp
,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
,CASE
    WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT' 
    WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'INSERT'
ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

FROM Temp_BNKM_PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN Temp_BNKM_PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint_TGT TGT
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.BonusPointTypeId = TGT.BonusPointTypeId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)


SELECT * INTO #Temp_BNKM_PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint_DELTA FROM Temp_BNKM_PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint_DELTA

--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM

INSERT INTO BNKM.PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint(
CustomerAccountId
,BonusPointTypeId
,BonusPointTimestamp
,BonusPointAmount
,SourceSystemCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
) SELECT DISTINCT
SRC.CustomerAccountId
,SRC.BonusPointTypeId
,SRC.BonusPointTimestamp
,SRC.BonusPointAmount
,SRC.SourceSystemCode
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,SRC.WorkFlowId
,SRC.TaskRunId
,SRC.InsertDttm
FROM #Temp_BNKM_PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint SRC
JOIN #Temp_BNKM_PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint_DELTA DLT
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = DLT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.BonusPointTypeId = DLT.BonusPointTypeId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = DLT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = DLT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #Temp_BNKM_PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint;
DROP TABLE #Temp_BNKM_PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint_DELTA;
DROP TABLE #Temp_BNKM_PaymentCardAccountBonusPoint_Union;


END
GO
